hotel.name: The Artist Grand Hotel of Art  Bilbao

verified_facts.text: The hotel is located opposite the Guggenheim Museum.
verified_facts.excerpt: Located opposite the Guggenheim Museum

verified_facts.text: The hotel is in Bilbao's artistic district, about 500 meters from the Museum of Fine Arts.
verified_facts.excerpt: In the heart of Bilbao’s artistic district, facing the Guggenheim Museum and just 500 meters from the Museum of Fine Arts

verified_facts.text: The hotel opened in 2002.
verified_facts.excerpt: Opened in 2002

verified_facts.text: The hotel describes itself as Spain's first entirely author-designed hotel.
verified_facts.excerpt: it is spain’s first entirely author-designed hotel

verified_facts.text: The project was carried out by architecture studio IA+B with artist Javier Mariscal and Fernando Salas.
verified_facts.excerpt: The architecture studio IA+B along with the artist Javier Mariscal and Fernando Salas carried out the project.

verified_facts.text: The lobby has a kinetic installation custom-made by the Swedish studio Humans Since 1982.
verified_facts.excerpt: A kinetic installation custom-made for the lobby by the Swedish studio Humans Since 1982.

verified_facts.text: The hallways have panels combining different woods, making each door a unique element.
verified_facts.excerpt: It continues through its hallways with its characteristic panels that combine different woods, making each door a unique element.

verified_facts.text: The wellness area features the Cross Check chair edited by Knoll, a nod to its creator, Guggenheim architect Frank Gehry.
verified_facts.excerpt: edited by Knoll in the Wellness area with a nod to its creator, the architect of the Guggenheim, Frank Gehry.

verified_facts.text: Javier Mariscal's work runs through every corner of the hotel.
verified_facts.excerpt: The work of Javier Mariscal permeates every corner of The Artist Hotel, transforming it into a living canvas.

verified_facts.text: The rooms house contemporary artworks, and some have windows looking onto the Guggenheim.
verified_facts.excerpt: rooms house various contemporary artworks. Some of them additionally feature another exceptional work through its windows: the Guggenheim itself.

verified_facts.text: Smart Inner View rooms look onto Javier Mariscal's stone cypress in the hotel's atrium.
verified_facts.excerpt: whilst enjoying a spectacular view on Javier Mariscal’s stone cypress in the atrium of the hotel.

verified_facts.text: Premier Guggenheim View rooms have panoramic windows and a Philippe Starck bathtub.
verified_facts.excerpt: Spacious rooms with panoramic windows that allow the unique experience of awakening with a view of the Guggenheim Museum. The Philippe Starck bathtub invites you to rest and relax and enjoy the views.

verified_facts.text: Junior Suites with Terrace have private terraces and can be connected, suiting families.
verified_facts.excerpt: Bright rooms with private terrace. These rooms can be connected with each other, which make them indispensable for a family stay.

verified_facts.text: The Penthouse Suite has two separate rooms and a private terrace overlooking the Guggenheim Museum.
verified_facts.excerpt: the spaciousness and comfort of its two separate rooms and the best private terrace overlooking the Guggenheim Museum.

verified_facts.text: The Rooftop has views of the Guggenheim Museum and is where guests have breakfast.
verified_facts.excerpt: Its privileged views of the Guggenheim Museum provide the backdrop for our guests

verified_facts.text: At The Rooftop, a drinks and snacks menu is served for watching sunsets over the estuary and the Guggenheim Museum.
verified_facts.excerpt: A menu of drinks and snacks to enjoy the sunsets over the estuary and the Guggenheim Museum.

verified_facts.text: At Olio, Abel Corral and Nelson Da Silva celebrate Basque-French cuisine.
verified_facts.excerpt:
crafted by the expert hands of Abel Corral in collaboration with Nelson Da Silva.

Together, they celebrate the richness of Basque-French cuisine

verified_facts.text: The Sixty-One lobby bar hosts live jazz concerts.
verified_facts.excerpt: Live jazz concerts complete the experience.

verified_facts.text: The Rooftop brunch is held once a month on special dates, with live music.
verified_facts.excerpt: Discover our luxurious Brunch, held once a month on special dates. It begins with a glass of champagne or Mimosa, which gives way to a varied and exclusive menu, enlivened with live music.

verified_facts.text: The wellness area offers a sauna, treatments and massages.
verified_facts.excerpt: Relax and revitalise in our wellness area: sauna, treatments, massages, and serene spaces designed for your physical and mental well-being.

verified_facts.text: The hotel has a fully equipped gym.
verified_facts.excerpt: Maintain your workout routine in our fully equipped gym featuring the latest technology

verified_facts.text: Pets are welcome, with adapted rooms, an extra bed, bowls and outdoor areas.
verified_facts.excerpt: Your pet is welcome. We offer adapted rooms, an additional bed, bowls, and outdoor areas

verified_facts.text: The hotel has private, secure parking with electric vehicle charging points and valet parking included.
verified_facts.excerpt: Enjoy private, secure parking with direct hotel access, electric vehicle charging points and valet parking included

verified_facts.text: Parking is charged, with the price covering the space and valet service.
verified_facts.excerpt: Price: €26 (includes parking space and valet service)

verified_facts.text: A concierge service can arrange reservations and recommend experiences.
verified_facts.excerpt: Our Concierge service is at your disposal to arrange your reservations, recommend unique experiences

verified_facts.text: The hotel follows sustainability practices including renewable energy, reduced plastics and recycling.
verified_facts.excerpt: We embrace environmentally responsible practices: renewable energy, reduced plastics, recycling, and eco-friendly products

verified_facts.text: 'Mariscal in Bilbao' is a special edition documenting Mariscal's contribution to the hotel, sold at the hotel.
verified_facts.excerpt: a special edition that compiles his contribution to the hotel, documenting iconic pieces, sketches, and the creative process behind each work.

unresolved.text: It is said Frank Gehry had to hold the railing when he saw his museum from the hotel's rooftop.
